test.create_query: CREATE TABLE exponential_time_decay_perf ( value Float64, time Float64 ) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO exponential_time_decay_perf SELECT toFloat64(number % 101 + 1), toFloat64(number) FROM numbers_mt(30000000) SETTINGS max_threads = 4
test.query: SELECT sum(value * exp((time - 29999999.) / 60.)) FROM exponential_time_decay_perf FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1

SELECT exponentialTimeDecayingValueAt( exponentialTimeDecayedSum(60)(value, time), toFloat64(29999999)) FROM exponential_time_decay_perf FORMAT Null SETTINGS allow_experimental_time_decay_aggregate_functions = 1, max_threads = 1

SELECT exponentialTimeDecayingValueAt( exponentialTimeDecayedSum(60)(value, toFloat64(0)), toFloat64(0)) FROM exponential_time_decay_perf FORMAT Null SETTINGS allow_experimental_time_decay_aggregate_functions = 1, max_threads = 1

SELECT exponentialTimeDecayingValueAt( exponentialTimeDecayedSumMerge(60)(state), toFloat64(29999999)) FROM ( SELECT exponentialTimeDecayedSumState(60)(value, time) AS state FROM exponential_time_decay_perf GROUP BY intDiv(toUInt64(time), 4096) ) FORMAT Null SETTINGS allow_experimental_time_decay_aggregate_functions = 1, max_threads = 1
